weights.load_checkpoint.inputs: Checkpoint shards and manifest, expected tensor names and shapes, and loader settings.
weights.load_checkpoint.outputs: A directory binding each model parameter to its source shard, byte range, shape and data type, or an error identifying an invalid entry.

weights.prepare_artifact.inputs: Source tensors and vocabulary, architecture metadata, target weight format and permitted numerical error.
weights.prepare_artifact.outputs: An engine-readable weight pack with vocabulary, tensor layout and quantization scales.

weights.decode_blocks.inputs: Packed weight blocks, their format and scales, tensor dimensions and the layout the kernel accepts.
weights.decode_blocks.outputs: Decoded weight values or equivalent packed blocks in the requested kernel layout.

weights.adapter_binding.inputs: Base model identity, adapter tensors, the adapter ID on each request and available adapter capacity.
weights.adapter_binding.outputs: Validated adapter handles and request-specific projection updates for the matching model layers.

placement.partition_model.inputs: Tensor sizes and source locations, available devices and storage, memory reserved for live requests, and placement policy.
placement.partition_model.outputs: A placement plan assigning weight ranges to memory or storage, with transfer boundaries and budgets for the runtime cache, or an infeasible-plan error.

engine.expert_streaming.inputs: Selected expert IDs, checkpoint byte ranges, placement and slot budgets, optional prefetch hints, and completion signals from readers.
engine.expert_streaming.outputs: Ready weight handles for the expert computation, with completion events and slot state that track when the weights can be replaced.

backend.execute_operators.inputs: An operator and its tensors, shapes, layouts and data types, plus device capabilities and execution stream.
backend.execute_operators.outputs: Computed output tensors and the selected implementation, or a fallback decision or error for unsupported inputs.

graph.lower_capture_replay.inputs: Model operations, tensor types and shapes, buffer addresses and backend capture capabilities.
graph.lower_capture_replay.outputs: An executable graph and, for a reusable launch, a capture entry keyed to its shape and buffers. An incompatible launch takes the eager or recapture path.

memory.reusable_sessions.inputs: Prompt prefix, model and adapter identities, saved sequence state, active references and available cache capacity.
memory.reusable_sessions.outputs: The length and state handle of the longest compatible saved prefix, or a miss that starts fresh prefill.

memory.runtime_arenas.inputs: Buffer sizes and lifetimes, memory limits, mapped weight ranges and allocation granularity.
memory.runtime_arenas.outputs: Allocations and mapped views with addresses valid through the last reader, plus committed and peak memory usage.

memory.sequence_kv.inputs: Sequence IDs and positions, new key and value rows, window and layout rules, and page capacity.
memory.sequence_kv.outputs: Updated key and value pages and a sequence-specific view of the valid positions that attention can read.

parallel.expert_exchange.inputs: Token rows, selected expert IDs and mixture weights, replica locations, and device-local slot assignments.
parallel.expert_exchange.outputs: Expert work grouped at the destination devices and weighted results returned to the corresponding source tokens.

parallel.model_execution.inputs: Device topology and peer capabilities, model shard assignments, and the current batch and sequence state.
parallel.model_execution.outputs: Device-local batches, combined partial results and completion signals. A separate decode device also receives a validated sequence-state handle.

routing.forecast_expert_demand.inputs: Prior expert selections and other features already available before the authoritative routing decision.
routing.forecast_expert_demand.outputs: Predicted expert IDs and timing or confidence information for optional early fetches.
